energyStandards.title: Energy Conservation Program for Consumer Products: Cooking Products
energyStandards.description: Prescribes standardized test procedures (Appendix I) evaluating cooktop and oven annual energy consumption, thermal efficiency ratios, and standby power draw.

energyStandards.title: ENERGY STAR Residential Dishwashers & Electric Cooking Products
energyStandards.description: Mandates maximum 3.5 gallons/cycle and 270 kWh/year for standard dishwashers, verifying 35% less water and 12% less energy than federal minimum standards.

energyStandards.title: Induction vs. Gas Cooking Efficiency & Indoor Air Quality Assessment
energyStandards.description: Empirical testing measuring 84–90% thermal transfer efficiency for magnetic induction cooktops versus 38–40% for natural gas open burners, with zero combustion emissions.

energyStandards.title: Ecodesign Requirements for Domestic Ovens, Hobs, and Range Hoods
energyStandards.description: Enforces Energy Efficiency Index (EEI) thresholds and limits energy consumption to ≤193 Wh/kg for electric hobs and ≤0.80 kWh/cycle for convection electric ovens.

energyStandards.agency: Rocky Mountain Institute & Int. J. Environ. Res. Public Health
energyStandards.title: Population Attributable Fraction of Gas Stove Use to Pediatric Asthma
energyStandards.description: Peer-reviewed epidemiological analysis finding 12.7% of current childhood asthma in the US is attributable to gas stove NO2 and particulate combustion emissions.

appliances.name: Induction Cooktop (Magnetic Flux)
appliances.indoorPollutants: Zero direct emissions (0 NO2, 0 CO, 0 PM2.5)
appliances.summary: Electromagnetic coils induce eddy currents directly in ferromagnetic cookware bases. ~88% of electrical energy converts straight into food heat with zero ambient heat loss or toxic fumes.

appliances.name: Rapid-Boil Electric Kettle
appliances.summary: Submerged direct heating element transfers 89% of energy immediately to water with rapid auto-shutoff when boiling. Fastest and most efficient water heating appliance.

appliances.name: Air Fryer / Compact Convection
appliances.summary: High-velocity convective air circulation within a compact 4–6 quart chamber. Reaches 200°C in 2 minutes and cooks 60–75% faster than large ovens with fraction of electrical draw.

appliances.name: Microwave Oven (1000W Cavity)
appliances.summary: Dielectric heating rotates polar water and fat molecules at 2.45 GHz. Zero cavity preheating required; unbeatable energy efficiency for steaming and reheating single portions.

appliances.name: Electric Pressure Cooker (Instant Pot)
appliances.summary: Hermetically sealed vessel traps steam to reach 121°C (15 PSI), reducing braising and stewing times by up to 70% with virtually zero evaporative thermal escape.

appliances.name: Electric Radiant / Ceramic Glass Cooktop
appliances.summary: Nichrome heating coils under ceramic glass transfer heat via conduction. Compatible with all cookware, but suffers from thermal inertia and slower temperature regulation.

appliances.name: Standard Full-Size Electric Oven
appliances.summary: Massive 120–150L steel cavity requires 15 minutes of preheating. 85% of total consumed energy heats the oven walls and room air rather than the food.

appliances.name: Gas Cooktop / Natural Gas Range
appliances.indoorPollutants: High NO2 (150–400 ppb), fine PM2.5, carbon monoxide, unburned benzene
appliances.summary: Open methane flame allows >60% of heat to bypass cookware and escape into the room. Generates significant indoor air pollution requiring continuous outdoor-vented exhaust.

appliances.name: Standard Full-Size Gas Oven
appliances.indoorPollutants: Continuous combustion exhaust moisture and NO2 into living space
appliances.summary: Continuous airflow required for methane combustion carries substantial convective heat out flue vents. The least thermally efficient cooking appliance (~8% efficiency).

appliances.name: ENERGY STAR Modern Dishwasher
appliances.summary: Cleans 12–14 complete place settings using only 3.2 gallons (12 L) of water. Internal flow-through water heater cuts overall energy use by 68% compared to handwashing.

appliances.name: Manual Hand Washing (Running Hot Tap)
appliances.summary: Running 48°C (120°F) hot tap water for 15–20 minutes to wash dinner dishes consumes 18.5 gallons of heated water and 3.6 kWh of water heater energy — 3.1x more energy than a dishwasher.

tasks.title: Boil 1 Liter (4.2 Cups) of Water
tasks.description: Heating 1.0 kg of tap water from 20°C to 100°C for tea, coffee, or pasta prep.

applianceOptions.notes: Fastest and most efficient: submerged heating element transfers heat directly into water.
Rapid magnetic base heating with minimal ambient heat loss.
Convenient for mugs, but slower and less efficient for full 1-liter vessels.
Thermal lag through ceramic glass wastes heat warming the glass surface.
Open methane flames curl around pot base, radiating heat into kitchen air.

tasks.title: Bake 2 Large Russet Potatoes
tasks.description: Baking 2 large russet potatoes (~600g total) until tender (core 98°C/208°F).

applianceOptions.notes: Instant excitation of internal moisture cooks tender in 8 min with 92% less energy than oven.
Yields ultra-crisp skin with 63% lower energy draw than a full-size oven.
15 min preheat + 45 min bake. Consumes 12x more electricity than a microwave.
Massive cavity volume and chimney exhaust result in highest energy waste.

tasks.title: Roast 1.5 lb Chicken & Root Vegetables
tasks.description: Roasting seasoned chicken breast and diced root vegetables at 200°C (400°F).

applianceOptions.notes: Rapid 2-minute preheat and localized high-speed airflow cut energy use by 72%.
15 min preheat + 35 min roast; high thermal cavity loss for a single meal.
Continuous methane combustion with high indoor heat dispersion.

tasks.title: Reheat Leftover Meal Plate
tasks.description: Heating a cold 400g plate of pasta/rice with protein from 4°C to 74°C (165°F).

applianceOptions.notes: Fastest and lowest carbon: 95% less energy than preheating a standard oven.
Skillet reheat with tight lid preserves texture with modest energy use.
Restores crispness to leftover pizza or roasted meats with minimal draw.
12 min preheat just to warm 400g of food — 19x more energy than microwave!

tasks.title: Bake a 12-Inch Frozen Pizza
tasks.description: Baking a 12-inch frozen pizza from -18°C to crispy golden at 220°C (425°F).

applianceOptions.notes: Compact countertop convection cooks crispy crust in half the time of standard oven.
15 min preheat + 15 min bake; 71% of energy wasted heating unused oven chamber.
Substantial flue gas venting and high greenhouse gas footprint.

tasks.title: Simmer Soup or Stew for 1 Hour
tasks.description: Cooking a 2.5-liter pot of beef stew or vegetable soup at low simmer.

applianceOptions.notes: Hermetic pressure cooking finishes stew in 25 min under pressure with zero steam loss.
Low 350W pulsed simmer with tight lid maintains steady temperature with low loss.
Heater element cycles on low, maintaining gentle simmer.
Open low flame radiates excess heat; releases continuous indoor NO2 combustion fumes.

tasks.title: Clean Dinner Dishes (4-Person Meal)
tasks.description: Washing 12 place settings, cutlery, glassware, and cookware after dinner.

applianceOptions.notes: Heats only 3.2 gallons with internal high-efficiency heater. Saves 68% energy vs handwashing.
Running hot tap water (48°C) for 15–20 min wastes ~18.5 gallons of heated water and 3.6 kWh.

tasks.title: Hard-Boil 6 Eggs
tasks.description: Cooking 6 large eggs in boiling water or steam for 10 minutes.

applianceOptions.notes: 5-5-5 steam method uses only 1 cup of water, making shells slip off effortlessly.
Boils water in 3.5 min, then 10 min gentle simmer with lid.
Longer heat-up time through glass cooktop increases total consumption.
Lowest efficiency: >65% of gas heat bypasses pot into kitchen.

annualSavingsBenchmarks.title: Switching from Full Oven to Air Fryer (4x per week)
annualSavingsBenchmarks.summary: Roasting small portions or baking snacks in a 1600W air fryer instead of a 3000W oven eliminates 15 minutes of preheating and saves 316 kWh annually.

annualSavingsBenchmarks.title: Running Tap Handwashing to ENERGY STAR Dishwasher (Daily)
annualSavingsBenchmarks.summary: Switching from handwashing dinner dishes under running hot water to a full ENERGY STAR dishwasher cycle saves over 5,500 gallons of hot water and ~890 kWh annually.

annualSavingsBenchmarks.title: Switching from Gas Cooktop to Induction (Daily cooking)
annualSavingsBenchmarks.summary: Upgrading from 39% efficient gas flame to 88% efficient induction cuts cooking carbon emissions by more than half and completely eliminates indoor NO2 gas spikes.

annualSavingsBenchmarks.title: Reheating Leftovers in Microwave vs. Oven (5x per week)
annualSavingsBenchmarks.summary: Reheating cold plates in a 1000W microwave takes 2.5 minutes vs 25 minutes in an oven, using 95% less electricity every time.
